civic.title: JDA Hoboken Business Center, LLC. to make a presentation before the Board of Commissioners for the properties identified as Block 6001 Lot 45 and commonly known by the street New York Avenue within the Hoboken Avenue Redevelopment Area. The redeveloper proposes to develop a mid-rise, mixed-use development containing multi-family residential with no fewer than 300 dwelling units, structured parking, and ground level commercial space. The proposed project will maintain the functionality of the drainage basin while incorporating publicly accessible open space and improving the existing Second Street Light Rail walkway/bike path to create a safer, more welcoming connection.
